{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni (born 18 August 1954 in Rome) is an Italian astrophysicist, science writer and a former ESA astronaut, being the first European to visit the International Space Station. He is a veteran of two NASA Space Shuttle missions. He was also a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 2004 to 2009, with the Group of the European United Left (GUE/NGL).", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni (* 18. srpna 1954 \u0158\u00edm, It\u00e1lie) je italsk\u00fd levicov\u00fd politik a b\u00fdval\u00fd astronaut. P\u016fvodn\u011b fyzik, od roku 1989 pat\u0159il mezi astronauty italsk\u00e9 kosmick\u00e9 agentury ASI, roku 1998 p\u0159e\u0161el do sboru astronaut\u016f ESA. V letech 1996 a 2001 absolvoval kr\u00e1tkodob\u00e9 kosmick\u00e9 lety (STS-75 a STS-100) v americk\u00fdch raketopl\u00e1nech Space Shuttle, p\u0159i druh\u00e9m nav\u0161t\u00edvil Mezin\u00e1rodn\u00ed vesm\u00edrnou stanici. Celkem str\u00e1vil ve vesm\u00edru 27 dn\u00ed, 15 hodin a 13 minut. Z odd\u00edlu kosmonaut\u016f ode\u0161el pot\u00e9, co byl roku 2004 na p\u011bt let zvolen \u010dlenem Evropsk\u00e9ho parlamentu za Stranu italsk\u00fdch komunist\u016f. Od roku 2010 je ve stran\u011b zodpov\u011bdn\u00fd za oblast vzd\u011bl\u00e1n\u00ed.", "xml:lang": "cs"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni (lahir 18 Agustus 1954) adalah seorang astrofisikawan, penulis sains dan mantan antariksawan ESA asal Italia. Ia menjadi orang Eropa pertama yang datang ke Stasiun Antariksa Internasional. Ia adalah veteran dari dua misi pesawat ulang alik NASA. Ia juga merupakan dari 2004 sampai 2009, terpilih dalam Partai Komunis Italia.", "xml:lang": "in"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni (ur. 18 sierpnia 1954 w Rzymie) \u2013 w\u0142oski astrofizyk, astronauta, uczestnik dw\u00f3ch misji NASA, polityk, eurodeputowany w latach 2004\u20132009.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni (* 18. August 1954 in Rom, Italien) ist ein italienischer Physiker, ehemaliger Astronaut und Abgeordneter des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni (Roma, 18 agosto 1954) \u00e8 un astronauta, astrofisico, scrittore ed ex politico italiano. Ha partecipato a due missioni NASA a bordo dello Space Shuttle. Nel 2001 \u00e8 stato il primo astronauta europeo a visitare la Stazione Spaziale Internazionale. \u00c8 stato europarlamentare dal 2004 al 2009.", "xml:lang": "it"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni, n\u00e9 \u00e0 Rome le 18 ao\u00fbt 1954, est un spationaute italien, d\u00e9put\u00e9 europ\u00e9en et ancien membre du GUE/NGL (juin 2004) qu'il quitte fin 2008 pour fonder Unir la Gauche et s'allier en mars 2009 \u00e0 Gauche et Libert\u00e9.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni (Roma, 18 de agosto de 1954) foi um astronauta italiano, veterano de duas miss\u00f5es do \u00f4nibus espacial e mais tarde um pol\u00edtico em seu pa\u00eds, membro do Partido dos Comunistas Italianos, um dos partidos comunistas da It\u00e1lia.", "xml:lang": "pt"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Umberto Guidoni (Rome, 18 augustus 1954) is een Italiaans voormalig ruimtevaarder van de ESA. Guidoni zijn eerste ruimtevlucht was STS-75 en vond plaats op 22 februari 1996. Tijdens de missie werden experimenten uitgevoerd met het Tethered Satellite System (TSS-1R). In totaal heeft Guidoni twee ruimtevluchten op zijn naam staan. Tijdens STS-100 werd hij de eerste Europeaan aan boord van het Internationaal ruimtestation ISS. Hij was lid van het Europees astronautenkorps. Van 2004 t/m 2009 was hij lid van het Europees Parlement namens de fractie Europees Unitair Links/Noords Groen Links.", "xml:lang": "nl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Lutz Goepel (born 10 October 1942 in Gotha, Thuringia) is a German politician who served as a Member of the European Parliament from 1994 until 2009, representing Saxony. He is a member of the conservative Christian Democratic Union, part of the European People's Party. In 1990 he was elected as a member of the People's Chamber of the German Democratic Republic, representing the Democratic Farmers' Party of Germany (DBD), which later merged with the CDU.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Lutz Goepel (* 10. Oktober 1942 in Gotha) war von 1994 bis 2009 ein Europaabgeordneter der CDU f\u00fcr Sachsen und Mitglied des Vorstands der Europ\u00e4ischen Volkspartei.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Lutz Goepel (ur. 10 pa\u017adziernika 1942 w Gocie) \u2013 niemiecki polityk, przez trzy kadencje pose\u0142 do Parlamentu Europejskiego z ramienia CDU.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Hella Ranner (ur. 10 maja 1951 w Grazu) \u2013 austriacka prawniczka i polityk, od 2009 do 2011 pos\u0142anka do Parlamentu Europejskiego.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Hella Ranner (* 10. Mai 1951 in Graz) ist eine \u00f6sterreichische Politikerin (\u00d6VP) und war zuletzt seit 2009 Mitglied des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kyriakos Mavronikolas (born 25 January 1955) is a Cypriot Movement for Social Democracy politician. He served as the Cypriot Minister of Defence from 2003 to 2006, and he sat as a Member of the European Parliament for Cyprus from 2009 to 2012, when he vacated his seat and was replaced by Sophocles Sophocleous. Mavronikolas is a graduate of the University of Athens faculty of medicine, and outside politics he works as an ophthalmologist.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kyriacos Mavronicholas (Grieks: \u039a\u03c5\u03c1\u03b9\u03ac\u03ba\u03bf\u03c2 \u039c\u03b1\u03c5\u03c1\u03bf\u03bd\u03b9\u03ba\u03cc\u03bb\u03b1\u03c2) (Paphos, 15 januari 1955) is een Cypriotisch politicus voor de Kinima Sosialdimokraton (EDEK). Na zijn afstuderen aan de medicijnenfaculteit van de Universiteit van Athene werkte hij vanaf 1990 als een oogarts. In 2003 werd hij vicevoorzitter van de EDEK. Van 2003 tot 2006 was hij een Cypriotische minister van defensie. In 2009 werd hij verkozen in het Europees Parlement. Op 31 augustus 2012 verliet hij het Europees Parlement en werd opgevolgd door Sophocles Sophocleous.", "xml:lang": "nl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kiriakos Mawronikolas, gr. \u039a\u03c5\u03c1\u03b9\u03ac\u03ba\u03bf\u03c2 \u039c\u03b1\u03c5\u03c1\u03bf\u03bd\u03b9\u03ba\u03cc\u03bb\u03b1\u03c2 (ur. 25 stycznia 1955 w Pafos) \u2013 cypryjski polityk i lekarz, by\u0142y minister, od 2009 do 2012 pose\u0142 do Parlamentu Europejskiego.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kyriakos Mavronikolas (* 25. Januar 1955 in Paphos) ist ein zypriotischer Politiker der Kinima Sosialdimokraton (EDEK). Nach seinem Abschluss an der Medizinischen Fakult\u00e4t der Kapodistrias-Universit\u00e4t in Athen arbeitete Mavronikolas von 1990 an als Augenarzt. 2003 wurde er stellvertretender Vorsitzender der EDEK. Von 2003 bis 2006 war er zypriotischer Verteidigungsminister. 2009 wurde er in das Europ\u00e4ische Parlament gew\u00e4hlt. Am 31. August 2012 verlie\u00df er dieses jedoch, sein Nachfolger ist Sophocles Sophocleous.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kyri\u00e1kos Mavronik\u00f3las, n\u00e9 le 25 janvier 1955, est un homme politique chypriote, membre du Mouvement pour la d\u00e9mocratie sociale (EDEK). Il a \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9lu d\u00e9put\u00e9 europ\u00e9en lors des \u00e9lections europ\u00e9ennes de 2009 \u00e0 Chypre, et si\u00e8ge au groupe Alliance progressiste des socialistes et d\u00e9mocrates au Parlement europ\u00e9en (S&D), jusqu'\u00e0 sa d\u00e9mission en faveur de Sofokl\u00eds Sofokl\u00e9ous en 2012.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Christopher Beazley (born 5 September 1952) is a British politician who served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 1984 to 1994 and again from 1999 to 2009. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Christopher Beazley (* 5. September 1952 in Bexhill-on-Sea, East Sussex) ist ein britischer Politiker der Conservative Party. Christopher Beazley ist der Sohn des Politikers . Er studierte Geschichte an der Bristol University und schloss sein Studium mit dem akademischen Grad Bachelor of Arts ab. Nach seinem Studium war er zwei Jahre lang von 1874 bis 1976 f\u00fcr die Bank of England und danach von 1976 bis 1983 als Lehrer t\u00e4tig, sp\u00e4ter als Research Officer an der Sussex University. Beazley war von 1984 bis 1994 und von 1999 bis 2009 Abgeordneter im Europ\u00e4ischen Parlament.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Claire Gibault (born 31 October 1945 in Le Mans) is a French conductor and politician and a Member of the European Parliament for the south-east of France. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Catherine Guy-Quint (born 1 September 1949 in Poitiers, Vienne) is a French politician and Member of the European Parliament for central France. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (Bojnice, 7 de junio de 1948)\u200b es una m\u00e9dica, pol\u00edtica y parlamentaria eslovaca. Estudi\u00f3 otorrinolaringolog\u00eda en la Universidad Comenius de Bratislava en Eslovaquia. Ejerci\u00f3 la medicina en Francia, Argelia, Reino Unido y Eslovaquia. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (* 7. Juni 1948 in Z\u00fcrich) ist eine slowakische Politikerin der und von 2004 bis 2019 Mitglied des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments. Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 war von 1990 bis 2019 Mitglied der KDH und gr\u00fcndete im Februar 2019 zusammen mit Branislav \u0160kripek die Kres\u0165ansk\u00e1 \u00fania, dessen Vorsitzende sie bis heute ist. Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 hat Medizin an der Comenius-Universit\u00e4t Bratislava studiert und wurde 1978 Fach\u00e4rztin f\u00fcr Hals-Nasen-Ohren-Heilkunde. Seit 1993 nahm sie mehrere \u00c4mter in der christlich-demokratischen Partei KDH ein, 1999 bis 2000 war sie als stellvertretende Vorsitzende f\u00fcr internationale Fragen zust\u00e4ndig. 1998 bis 2004 geh\u00f6rte sie dem slowakischen Parlament an, wo sie Mitglied des gemischten parlamentarischen Ausschusses EU-Slowakei war, der den slowakischen EU-Beitritt 2004 vorbereitete. Ab 2003 war Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 Beobachterin im Europ\u00e4ischen Parlament; bei der Europawahl 2004, bei der die Slowakei erstmals teilnahm, wurde sie als Abgeordnete gew\u00e4hlt. Im Europaparlament geh\u00f6rt Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 der christdemokratisch-konservativen Fraktion EVP-ED an und war in der Legislaturperiode 2004\u201309 Vorsitzende im Ausschuss f\u00fcr die Rechte der Frau und die Gleichstellung der Geschlechter sowie Mitglied im Ausschuss f\u00fcr Entwicklung. In der folgenden Legislaturperiode trat sie in Erscheinung, indem sie sich f\u00fcr ein europ\u00e4isches Fr\u00fchwarnsystems gegen P\u00e4dophilie und sexuelle Bel\u00e4stigung engagierte. Eine entsprechende Schriftliche Erkl\u00e4rung des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments wurde im Juni 2010 von 371 der 732 Abgeordneten angenommen. Der Vorschlag stie\u00df allerdings bei anderen Parlamentariern wie Cecilia Wikstr\u00f6m auch auf Kritik, da er ein Modell der Vorratsdatenspeicherung impliziere.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (n\u00e9e le 7 juin 1948 \u00e0 Zurich) est une femme politique slovaque, membre du Mouvement chr\u00e9tien-d\u00e9mocrate (KDH). De 2004 \u00e0 2019, elle est d\u00e9put\u00e9e europ\u00e9enne, membre du Groupe du Parti populaire europ\u00e9en (PPE), le plus grand des sept groupes politiques du Parlement europ\u00e9en, qui est li\u00e9 au Parti populaire europ\u00e9en (PPE).", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

D\u00e9put\u00e9 entre 1994 et 1999, il occupe, pendant les dix ann\u00e9es suivantes, le poste de maire de la ville de Florence. En 2009, il est \u00e9lu d\u00e9put\u00e9 europ\u00e9en.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}
{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Leonardo Domenici (born 12 July 1955) is an Italian politician. He served as Mayor of Florence from 1999 to 2009.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jamila B\u00e1rbara Madeira e Madeira, conhecida como Jamila Madeira (Loul\u00e9, Alte, 17 de julho de 1975), \u00e9 uma pol\u00edtica portuguesa.", "xml:lang": "pt"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jamila Madeira (born 17 July 1975) is a Portuguese politician and Member of the European Parliament for the Socialist Party; part of the Party of European Socialists. She was part of the National Board of Juventude Socialista from 1994 to 2000, and then became its General Secretary from 2000 to 2004. She was a member of the Assembly of the Republic from 1999 to 2004.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jamila B\u00e1rbara Madeira e Madeira conocida como Jamila Madeira (Alte, Loul\u00e9, 17 de julio de 1975\u200b) es una pol\u00edtica portuguesa, siendo actualmente (y desde julio de 2004) diputada por el Partido Socialista Europeo en el Parlamento Europeo.", "xml:lang": "es"}}

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01: {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (Bojnice, 7 de junio de 1948)\u200b es una m\u00e9dica, pol\u00edtica y parlamentaria eslovaca. Estudi\u00f3 otorrinolaringolog\u00eda en la Universidad Comenius de Bratislava en Eslovaquia. Ejerci\u00f3 la medicina en Francia, Argelia, Reino Unido y Eslovaquia. Fue parlamentaria europea, pertenece al partido Movimiento Dem\u00f3crata Cristiano.\u200b\u200b Contrajo matrimonio con Vladimir Z\u00e1borsk\u00fd y es madre de dos hijas: Veronika y Eva.", "xml:lang": "es"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (* 7. Juni 1948 in Z\u00fcrich) ist eine slowakische Politikerin der und von 2004 bis 2019 Mitglied des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments. Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 war von 1990 bis 2019 Mitglied der KDH und gr\u00fcndete im Februar 2019 zusammen mit Branislav \u0160kripek die Kres\u0165ansk\u00e1 \u00fania, dessen Vorsitzende sie bis heute ist. Im Europaparlament geh\u00f6rt Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 der christdemokratisch-konservativen Fraktion EVP-ED an und war in der Legislaturperiode 2004\u201309 Vorsitzende im Ausschuss f\u00fcr die Rechte der Frau und die Gleichstellung der Geschlechter sowie Mitglied im Ausschuss f\u00fcr Entwicklung.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (n\u00e9e le 7 juin 1948 \u00e0 Zurich) est une femme politique slovaque, membre du Mouvement chr\u00e9tien-d\u00e9mocrate (KDH). De 2004 \u00e0 2019, elle est d\u00e9put\u00e9e europ\u00e9enne, membre du Groupe du Parti populaire europ\u00e9en (PPE), le plus grand des sept groupes politiques du Parlement europ\u00e9en, qui est li\u00e9 au Parti populaire europ\u00e9en (PPE).", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 nata Neuwirthov\u00e1 (Zurigo, 7 giugno 1948) \u00e8 una politica e medico svizzera naturalizzata slovacca. Fa parte del partito Movimento Cristiano-Democratico. Dal 2004 \u00e8 membro del Parlamento europeo, dove \u00e8 parte del gruppo del Partito popolare europeo (PPE).", "xml:lang": "it"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (* 7. \u010dervna 1948, Curych, \u0160v\u00fdcarsko) je slovensk\u00e1 konzervativn\u00ed politi\u010dka. Je dcerou n\u011bkdej\u0161\u00edho v\u00fdznamn\u00e9ho politika KDH a man\u017eelkou architekta .", "xml:lang": "cs"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (Zurique, 7 de junho de 1948) \u00e9 deputada pela Eslov\u00e1quia ao Parlamento Europeu pelo Grupo do Partido Popular Europeu (Democratas-Crist\u00e3os) e dos e Presidente da Comiss\u00e3o dos Direitos da Mulher e da Igualdade dos G\u00e9neros do Parlamento Europeu (FEM).", "xml:lang": "pt"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (ur. 7 czerwca 1948 w Zurychu) \u2013 s\u0142owacka lekarka i polityk, deputowana do Parlamentu Europejskiego V (w 2004) oraz VI, VII i VIII kadencji.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Anna Z\u00e1borsk\u00e1 (born 7 June 1948 in Z\u00fcrich) is a Slovak politician of the Christian Union party, living in Bojnice. From 2004 to 2019 she was a Member of the European Parliament, where she was a member of the Group of the European People's Party (EPP). She was a member of the Christian Democratic Movement party (KDH).", "xml:lang": "en"}}

Seit 2009 geh\u00f6rt sie dem Europ\u00e4ischen Parlament an.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Pascale Gruny (born 18 February 1960) was a member of the National Assembly of France. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jean-Marie Cavada (\u00c9pinal, 24 februari 1940) is een Frans politicus.", "xml:lang": "nl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jean-Marie Cavada (\u00c9pinal, 24 de febrer de 1940) \u00e9s un pol\u00edtic i periodista franc\u00e8s i eurodiputat per a l'. Des de 2011 \u00e9s el president del Moviment Europeu Fran\u00e7a. Va ser membre de l'antiga Uni\u00f3 per a la Democr\u00e0cia Francesa, que va formar part de l'Alian\u00e7a dels Liberals i Dem\u00f2crates per Europa. Com a diputat pel sud-oest de Fran\u00e7a, presideix la del Parlament Europeu, \u00e9s substitut de la Comissi\u00f3 d'Afers Econ\u00f2mics i Monetaris i membre de la delegaci\u00f3 a la Comissi\u00f3 Parlament\u00e0ria Mixta UE-Romania, de 2004 a 2009. Despr\u00e9s del naixement del Moviment Dem\u00f2crata, amb membres procedents de la Uni\u00f3 per a la Democr\u00e0cia Francesa, va crear el seu propi partit, . A les eleccions al Parlament Europeu de 2009, va ser el tercer membre de la llista de majoria presidencial (UMP/CN/), sota l'etiqueta de Nou Centre. \u00c9s membre del grup europeu de l'Alian\u00e7a dels Liberals i Dem\u00f2crates per Europa. El 2015 va proposar restringir la llibertat de panorama als pa\u00efsos de la Uni\u00f3 Europea, una mesura que va ser rebutjada \u00e0mpliament pel Parlament Europeu. En la seva carrera period\u00edstica, va ser director d'informaci\u00f3 de France 2, France 3 i TF1 (1974-1982), director general de FR5 (1994-1997) i del grup Radio France (1998-2004).", "xml:lang": "ca"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jean-Marie Cavada, f\u00f6dd 24 februari 1940, \u00e4r en fransk politiker och tidigare journalist. Fr\u00e5n sent 1960-tal och fram till tidigt 2000-tal var han verksam som redakt\u00f6r eller i olika chefspositioner p\u00e5 ett antal rikst\u00e4ckande franska radio- och TV-kanaler. 2004 inledde Cavada ist\u00e4llet en karri\u00e4r som politiker, och samma \u00e5r valdes han in som ledamot av Europaparlamentet. Han \u00e4r sedan 3 december 2011 ordf\u00f6rande f\u00f6r den franska grenen av den tv\u00e4rpolitiska .", "xml:lang": "sv"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jean-Marie Cavada (* 24. Februar 1940 in \u00c9pinal, D\u00e9partement Vosges) ist ein franz\u00f6sischer Journalist und Politiker. Er war von 2004 bis 2019 Mitglied des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jean-Marie Cavada (born 24 February 1940 in \u00c9pinal, Vosges) is a French politician and former journalist and media executive who last served as a Member of the European Parliament for Ile de France from 2004 until 2019. Since 3 December 2011 he is president of the European Movement France.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Garrelt Duin (n\u00e9 le 2 avril 1968 \u00e0 Leer) est un homme politique socialiste allemand. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kyriakos Mavronikolas (born 25 January 1955) is a Cypriot Movement for Social Democracy politician. He served as the Cypriot Minister of Defence from 2003 to 2006, and he sat as a Member of the European Parliament for Cyprus from 2009 to 2012, when he vacated his seat and was replaced by Sophocles Sophocleous. Mavronikolas is a graduate of the University of Athens faculty of medicine, and outside politics he works as an ophthalmologist.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kyriacos Mavronicholas (Grieks: \u039a\u03c5\u03c1\u03b9\u03ac\u03ba\u03bf\u03c2 \u039c\u03b1\u03c5\u03c1\u03bf\u03bd\u03b9\u03ba\u03cc\u03bb\u03b1\u03c2) (Paphos, 15 januari 1955) is een Cypriotisch politicus voor de Kinima Sosialdimokraton (EDEK). Na zijn afstuderen aan de medicijnenfaculteit van de Universiteit van Athene werkte hij vanaf 1990 als een oogarts. In 2003 werd hij vicevoorzitter van de EDEK. Van 2003 tot 2006 was hij een Cypriotische minister van defensie. In 2009 werd hij verkozen in het Europees Parlement. Op 31 augustus 2012 verliet hij het Europees Parlement en werd opgevolgd door Sophocles Sophocleous.", "xml:lang": "nl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kiriakos Mawronikolas, gr. \u039a\u03c5\u03c1\u03b9\u03ac\u03ba\u03bf\u03c2 \u039c\u03b1\u03c5\u03c1\u03bf\u03bd\u03b9\u03ba\u03cc\u03bb\u03b1\u03c2 (ur. 25 stycznia 1955 w Pafos) \u2013 cypryjski polityk i lekarz, by\u0142y minister, od 2009 do 2012 pose\u0142 do Parlamentu Europejskiego.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kyriakos Mavronikolas (* 25. Januar 1955 in Paphos) ist ein zypriotischer Politiker der Kinima Sosialdimokraton (EDEK). Nach seinem Abschluss an der Medizinischen Fakult\u00e4t der Kapodistrias-Universit\u00e4t in Athen arbeitete Mavronikolas von 1990 an als Augenarzt. 2003 wurde er stellvertretender Vorsitzender der EDEK. Von 2003 bis 2006 war er zypriotischer Verteidigungsminister. 2009 wurde er in das Europ\u00e4ische Parlament gew\u00e4hlt. Am 31. August 2012 verlie\u00df er dieses jedoch, sein Nachfolger ist Sophocles Sophocleous.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Kyri\u00e1kos Mavronik\u00f3las, n\u00e9 le 25 janvier 1955, est un homme politique chypriote, membre du Mouvement pour la d\u00e9mocratie sociale (EDEK). Il a \u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9lu d\u00e9put\u00e9 europ\u00e9en lors des \u00e9lections europ\u00e9ennes de 2009 \u00e0 Chypre, et si\u00e8ge au groupe Alliance progressiste des socialistes et d\u00e9mocrates au Parlement europ\u00e9en (S&D), jusqu'\u00e0 sa d\u00e9mission en faveur de Sofokl\u00eds Sofokl\u00e9ous en 2012.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Marco Rizzo (ur. 12 pa\u017adziernika 1959 w Turynie) \u2013 w\u0142oski polityk, dzia\u0142acz komunistyczny, by\u0142y parlamentarzysta krajowy, eurodeputowany w latach 2004\u20132009.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Marco Rizzo (* 12. Oktober 1959 in Turin) ist ein italienischer kommunistischer Politiker. Er war von 2004 bis 2009 Mitglied des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments. Seit 2009 ist er Generalsekret\u00e4r der Partito Comunista.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Marco Rizzo (Torino, 12 ottobre 1959) \u00e8 un politico italiano, dal 2009 segretario generale del Partito Comunista. \u00c8 cofondatore della lista elettorale Italia Sovrana e Popolare.", "xml:lang": "it"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Marco Rizzo (n\u00e9 le 12 octobre 1959 \u00e0 Turin) est un homme politique italien. Il adh\u00e8re au Parti communiste italien en 1981 jusqu'\u00e0 sa dissolution, puis en 1991 au Parti de la refondation communiste et ensuite en 1998 au Parti des communistes italiens. En juin 2009, il est exclu du Parti des communistes italiens pour avoir soutenu Gianni Vattimo aux \u00e9lections europ\u00e9ennes du m\u00eame mois. Il fonde alors son propre mouvement, Comunisti Sinistra Popolare (Communistes gauche populaire) qui est rebaptis\u00e9 Parti communiste en janvier 2014. Il est d\u00e9put\u00e9 europ\u00e9en de 2004 \u00e0 2009.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01: {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eleni Mavrou (Greek: \u0395\u03bb\u03ad\u03bd\u03b7 \u039c\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c5, El\u00e9ni M\u00e1vrou) is the Executive Chairman of Dialogos Media Group. Thus, Ms Mavrou became the first female mayor of the Nicosia, as well as the first female Minister of Interior. Born in Kyrenia in 1961, her family was forced to leave their house in 1974 due to the Turkish invasion of Cyprus, and since then has been residing in Nicosia.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eleni Mavrou (griechisch \u0395\u03bb\u03ad\u03bd\u03b7 \u039c\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c5; * 2. Als erste Frau war sie von 2007 bis 2011 B\u00fcrgermeisterin von Nikosia und von 2011 bis 2013 Innenministerin des Landes.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eleni Mawru, gr. \u0395\u03bb\u03ad\u03bd\u03b7 \u039c\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c5 (ur. 2 lutego 1961 w Kirenii) \u2013 cypryjska polityk, dzia\u0142aczka Post\u0119powej Partii Ludzi Pracy (AKEL), deputowana do Izby Reprezentant\u00f3w, deputowana do Parlamentu Europejskiego V kadencji (2004), w latach 2007\u20132011 burmistrz Nikozji, od 2012 do 2013 minister spraw wewn\u0119trznych.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eleni Mavrou (Grieks: \u0395\u03bb\u03ad\u03bd\u03b7 \u039c\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c5) (Girne, 2 februari 1961) is een Cypriotisch politica. Op 17 december 2006 werd Mavrou verkozen tot burgemeester van Nicosia. Ze werd hiermee de eerste vrouwelijke burgemeester van de hoofdstad van haar land. In 2011 werd ze niet herverkozen. Op 20 maart 2012 werd Mavrou benoemd als minister van Binnenlandse Zaken. Ook hier was ze de eerste vrouw die deze functie toegewezen kreeg. Mavrou is ridder in de Nationale Orde van Verdienste van Frankrijk.", "xml:lang": "nl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "El\u00e9ni M\u00e1vrou, n\u00e9e le 2 f\u00e9vrier 1961 \u00e0 Kyrenia est une femme politique chypriote. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jacek Emil Saryusz-Wolski, n\u00e9 le 19 septembre 1948 \u00e0 \u0141\u00f3d\u017a, est un homme politique polonais. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jacek Emil Saryusz-Wolski (* 19. September 1948 in \u0141\u00f3d\u017a) ist ein polnischer Politiker und MdEP. Er geh\u00f6rte der Platforma Obywatelska an.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jacek Emil Saryusz-Wolski (born 19 September 1948 in \u0141\u00f3d\u017a) is a Polish diplomat and PiS (Law and Justice) politician. He has been a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) since June 2004. He served as Vice President of the European Parliament (2004\u20132007). Saryusz-Wolski is chairman of the Executive Board of the \u201cFoundation College of Europe\u201d, in charge of the Natolin campus of the College of Europe.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jacek Emil Saryusz-Wolski (ur. 19 wrze\u015bnia 1948 w \u0141odzi) \u2013 polski ekonomista, europeista, polityk i urz\u0119dnik pa\u0144stwowy, jeden z g\u0142\u00f3wnych negocjator\u00f3w przyst\u0105pienia Polski do Unii Europejskiej. W latach 1991\u20131996 pierwszy pe\u0142nomocnik rz\u0105du do spraw integracji europejskiej i pomocy zagranicznej, w latach 2000\u20132001 sekretarz Komitetu Integracji Europejskiej, od 2004 deputowany do Parlamentu Europejskiego VI, VII, VIII i IX kadencji, w latach 2004\u20132007 wiceprzewodnicz\u0105cy PE VI kadencji, w latach 2007\u20132009 przewodnicz\u0105cy Komisji Spraw Zagranicznych PE, w latach 2006\u20132010 wiceprzewodnicz\u0105cy Platformy Obywatelskiej, w latach 2006\u20132017 wiceprzewodnicz\u0105cy Europejskiej Partii Ludowej.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jacek Emil Saryusz-Wolski (\u0141\u00f3d\u017a, 19 settembre 1948) \u00e8 un politico e diplomatico polacco. Membro del Parlamento europeo dal 13 giugno 2004, ha servito come uno dei suoi vicepresidenti per il PPE tra il 2004 e il 2007.", "xml:lang": "it"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jacek Emil Saryusz-Wolski, f\u00f6dd 19 september 1948 i \u0141\u00f3d\u017a, \u00e4r en polsk politiker. Han \u00e4r ledamot av Europaparlamentet sedan 2004 och var Europaparlamentets vice talman 2004\u20132007. Saryusz-Wolski valdes till en b\u00f6rjan till EU-parlamentet som kandidat f\u00f6r Medborgarplattformen och var ordf\u00f6rande f\u00f6r Europaparlamentets utskott f\u00f6r utrikesfr\u00e5gor 2007\u20132009. Han var vice ordf\u00f6rande i Europeiska folkpartiet 2006\u20132017. Polens regering motsatte sig 2017 omval av Donald Tusk som Europeiska r\u00e5dets ordf\u00f6rande och framf\u00f6rde Saryusz-Wolski som Polens kandidat ist\u00e4llet. Att Saruyusz-Wolski accepterade nomineringen ledde till ett brott med den gamla grupperingen. I omvaldes han som kandidat f\u00f6r Lag och r\u00e4ttvisa och ansl\u00f6t sig till Gruppen Europeiska konservativa och reformister.", "xml:lang": "sv"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Gitte Seeberg, n\u00e9e le 25 juin 1960 \u00e0 Copenhague, est une femme politique danoise. Membre du Parti populaire conservateur puis de l'Alliance lib\u00e9rale, elle si\u00e8ge au Folketing de 1994 \u00e0 2004 et de 2004 \u00e0 2008 et est d\u00e9put\u00e9e europ\u00e9enne de 2004 \u00e0 2007.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Gitte Seeberg (born 25 June 1960 in Copenhagen) is a Danish politician, lawyer, and current secretary general of the Danish branch of the WWF. She was a member of the Danish Folketinget parliament for the Conservative People's Party and New Alliance, and has previously been a Member of the European Parliament.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Gitte Seeberg, f\u00f6dd 25 juni 1960, \u00e4r en tidigare dansk EU-parlamentariker f\u00f6r Konservativa Folkpartiet. Hon satt i Folketinget fr\u00e5n 21 september 1994 tills hon kom in i EU-parlamentet, fr\u00e5n b\u00f6rjan f\u00f6r K\u00f6penhamns valkrets, men sedan 1998 f\u00f6r Roskildes valkrets. 2007 var hon med och bildade Ny Alliance p\u00e5 grund av missn\u00f6je med regeringens samarbete med Dansk Folkeparti. Hon blev d\u00e5 \u00e5ter invald i Folketinget, men l\u00e4mnade b\u00e5de detta och sitt nya parti \u00e5ret d\u00e4rp\u00e5. Hon har tagit kandidatexamen i juridik vid K\u00f6penhamns universitet.", "xml:lang": "sv"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "V\u00e9ronique Marie Alice Henriette De Keyser (born 23 March 1945 in Brussels) is a Belgian politician who served as a Member of the European Parliament from 2001 until 2014. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Marco Rizzo (* 12. Oktober 1959 in Turin) ist ein italienischer kommunistischer Politiker. Er war von 2004 bis 2009 Mitglied des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments. Seit 2009 ist er Generalsekret\u00e4r der Partito Comunista.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Marco Rizzo (Torino, 12 ottobre 1959) \u00e8 un politico italiano, dal 2009 segretario generale del Partito Comunista. \u00c8 cofondatore della lista elettorale Italia Sovrana e Popolare.", "xml:lang": "it"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Marco Rizzo (n\u00e9 le 12 octobre 1959 \u00e0 Turin) est un homme politique italien. Il adh\u00e8re au Parti communiste italien en 1981 jusqu'\u00e0 sa dissolution, puis en 1991 au Parti de la refondation communiste et ensuite en 1998 au Parti des communistes italiens. En juin 2009, il est exclu du Parti des communistes italiens pour avoir soutenu Gianni Vattimo aux \u00e9lections europ\u00e9ennes du m\u00eame mois. Il fonde alors son propre mouvement, Comunisti Sinistra Popolare (Communistes gauche populaire) qui est rebaptis\u00e9 Parti communiste en janvier 2014. Il est d\u00e9put\u00e9 europ\u00e9en de 2004 \u00e0 2009.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Marco Rizzo (born 12 October 1959 in Turin) is an Italian politician, leader of the Communist Party (PC) and in 2022 with Sovereign and Popular Italy.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

Staden \u00e4r bel\u00e4gen vid \u00d6stersj\u00f6n, vid inloppet till Kuriska sj\u00f6n. Staden \u00e4r bel\u00e4gen vid \u00d6stersj\u00f6n, vid inloppet till Kuriska sj\u00f6n. Staden \u00e4r bel\u00e4gen vid \u00d6stersj\u00f6n, vid inloppet till Kuriska sj\u00f6n. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Hella Ranner (born 10 March 1951 in Graz, Austria) was a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 2009 to 2011, representing the Austrian People's Party and the European People's Party Group.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Hella Ranner (* 10. Mai 1951 in Graz) ist eine \u00f6sterreichische Politikerin (\u00d6VP) und war zuletzt seit 2009 Mitglied des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Hella Ranner, n\u00e9e le 10 mai 1951 \u00e0 Graz en Autriche, est une femme politique autrichienne, d\u00e9put\u00e9e europ\u00e9enne de 2009 \u00e0 2011, repr\u00e9sentant le Parti populaire autrichien et le groupe du Parti populaire Europ\u00e9en", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eleni Mavrou (Greek: \u0395\u03bb\u03ad\u03bd\u03b7 \u039c\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c5, El\u00e9ni M\u00e1vrou) is the Executive Chairman of Dialogos Media Group. She served as Minister of Interior of the Republic of Cyprus until February 2013. Until 2011, she was the mayor of the capital city Nicosia for 5 years. Thus, Ms Mavrou became the first female mayor of the Nicosia, as well as the first female Minister of Interior. Born in Kyrenia in 1961, her family was forced to leave their house in 1974 due to the Turkish invasion of Cyprus, and since then has been residing in Nicosia.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eleni Mavrou (griechisch \u0395\u03bb\u03ad\u03bd\u03b7 \u039c\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c5; * 2. Februar 1961 in Kyrenia, Zypern) ist eine griechisch-zypriotische Politikerin (AKEL). Nach dem Beitritt Zyperns wurde sie 2004 Mitglied des Europ\u00e4ischen Parlaments. Als erste Frau war sie von 2007 bis 2011 B\u00fcrgermeisterin von Nikosia und von 2011 bis 2013 Innenministerin des Landes.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eleni Mawru, gr. \u0395\u03bb\u03ad\u03bd\u03b7 \u039c\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c5 (ur. 2 lutego 1961 w Kirenii) \u2013 cypryjska polityk, dzia\u0142aczka Post\u0119powej Partii Ludzi Pracy (AKEL), deputowana do Izby Reprezentant\u00f3w, deputowana do Parlamentu Europejskiego V kadencji (2004), w latach 2007\u20132011 burmistrz Nikozji, od 2012 do 2013 minister spraw wewn\u0119trznych.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eleni Mavrou (Grieks: \u0395\u03bb\u03ad\u03bd\u03b7 \u039c\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c5) (Girne, 2 februari 1961) is een Cypriotisch politica. Op 17 december 2006 werd Mavrou verkozen tot burgemeester van Nicosia. Ze werd hiermee de eerste vrouwelijke burgemeester van de hoofdstad van haar land. In 2011 werd ze niet herverkozen. Op 20 maart 2012 werd Mavrou benoemd als minister van Binnenlandse Zaken. Ook hier was ze de eerste vrouw die deze functie toegewezen kreeg. Mavrou is ridder in de Nationale Orde van Verdienste van Frankrijk.", "xml:lang": "nl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "El\u00e9ni M\u00e1vrou, n\u00e9e le 2 f\u00e9vrier 1961 \u00e0 Kyrenia est une femme politique chypriote. Elle est maire de Nicosie, capital de la Chypre du 1er janvier 2007 au 31 d\u00e9cembre 2011. Le 1er avril 2012, elle est nomm\u00e9e ministre de l'Int\u00e9rieur dans le Gouvernement Khrist\u00f3fias.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jacek Emil Saryusz-Wolski (\u0141\u00f3d\u017a, 19 settembre 1948) \u00e8 un politico e diplomatico polacco. Membro del Parlamento europeo dal 13 giugno 2004, ha servito come uno dei suoi vicepresidenti per il PPE tra il 2004 e il 2007.", "xml:lang": "it"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Jacek Emil Saryusz-Wolski, f\u00f6dd 19 september 1948 i \u0141\u00f3d\u017a, \u00e4r en polsk politiker. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Paul Andrew Nuttall (born 30 November 1976) is a British politician who served as Leader of the UK Independence Party (UKIP) from 2016 to 2017. He was elected to the European Parliament in 2009 as a UK Independence Party (UKIP) candidate, and served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for North West England between 2009 and 2019, sitting in the Europe of Freedom and Direct Democracy group. He left UKIP in December 2018, criticising the party's association with far-right activist Tommy Robinson, and joined The Brexit Party in 2019. Nuttall was a Conservative Party candidate in a council election in Sefton before joining UKIP in 2004. He became deputy leader of UKIP, deputising for Nigel Farage, in November 2010 and the party's spokesperson for education, life skills and training in July 2014. He was elected party leader in the November 2016 leadership election. Nuttall stood unsuccessfully for UKIP six times in parliamentary elections between 2005 and 2017, of which his best result was finishing second in the 2017 Stoke-on-Trent Central by-election. He resigned as party leader after coming third in Boston and Skegness in the 2017 general election, with his party losing most of its electoral support. A prominent eurosceptic, Nuttall has also called for the establishment of an English parliament. He favours a ban on wearing burqas in public places, has shown support for the reintroduction of the death penalty, and opposed Labour's 2015 plans to include LGBT-inclusive sex and relationship education in schools.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Paul Nuttall, n\u00e9 le 30 novembre 1976 \u00e0 Liverpool, est un homme politique britannique. Leader de l'UKIP de novembre 2016 \u00e0 juin 2017, il quitte ce parti en 2018 et rejoint le Parti du Brexit. Il est d\u00e9put\u00e9 europ\u00e9en de 2009 \u00e0 2019.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Paul Andrew Nuttall, nacido el 30 de noviembre de 1976, es un pol\u00edtico brit\u00e1nico, ex eurodiputado representando el Noroeste de Inglaterra por el Brexit Party. Fue elegido como representante del Partido de la Independencia del Reino Unido (UKIP), represent\u00e1ndolo entre 2009 y 2018.\u200b\u200b El 28 de noviembre de 2016, fue elegido como l\u00edder de UKIP.\u200b Despu\u00e9s de las elecciones generales del Reino Unido de 2017 expuso su renuncia del liderazgo.\u200b En diciembre de 2018 anunci\u00f3 su salida del partido.", "xml:lang": "es"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eduard Marie August \"Ward\" Beysen (ur. 26 czerwca 1941 w Mortsel, zm. 14 stycznia 2005 w ) \u2013 belgijski i flamandzki polityk, jeden z lider\u00f3w libera\u0142\u00f3w flamandzkich, samorz\u0105dowiec, pose\u0142 krajowy i regionalny, od 1999 do 2004 deputowany do Parlamentu Europejskiego V kadencji.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}
{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eduard Marie August (Ward) Beysen (Mortsel, 26 juni 1941 - Antwerpen (Wilrijk), 14 januari 2005) was een Belgisch liberaal politicus.", "xml:lang": "nl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Eduard Marie August \"Ward\" Beysen was a Belgian politician and well-known freemason. He held a degree in Dutch and history teaching, obtained in 1963 in Lier and started his political career in the seventies in the Flemish liberal party, the Party for Freedom and Progress (PVV), which was renamed Flemish Liberals and Democrats (VLD) in 1992. Ward Beysen - suffering a depression - died by drowning himself in the lake of Fort 6 in the south of Antwerp.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Helmut Kuhne (born 6 September 1949, in Soest) is a German politician who served as a Member of the European Parliament from 1994 until 2009. He is a member of the Social Democratic Party of Germany, part of the Socialist Group. During his time in parliament, Kuhne sat on the European Parliament's Committee on Foreign Affairs. He was also a member of the Delegation for relations with the United States.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Helmut Kuhne (ur. 6 wrze\u015bnia 1949 w Soest) \u2013 niemiecki polityk, socjolog, przez trzy kadencje pose\u0142 do Parlamentu Europejskiego (1994\u20132009).", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Helmut Kuhne (* 6. September 1949 in Soest) war von 1994 bis 2009 Europaabgeordneter f\u00fcr die SPD in der Sozialdemokratischen Fraktion im Europaparlament. Im Europaparlament war Helmut Kuhne Mitglied im Ausschuss f\u00fcr ausw\u00e4rtige Angelegenheiten, im Unterausschuss f\u00fcr Sicherheit und Verteidigung und in der Delegation f\u00fcr die Beziehungen zu den Vereinigten Staaten.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Gitte Seeberg, n\u00e9e le 25 juin 1960 \u00e0 Copenhague, est une femme politique danoise. Membre du Parti populaire conservateur puis de l'Alliance lib\u00e9rale, elle si\u00e8ge au Folketing de 1994 \u00e0 2004 et de 2004 \u00e0 2008 et est d\u00e9put\u00e9e europ\u00e9enne de 2004 \u00e0 2007.", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Gitte Seeberg (born 25 June 1960 in Copenhagen) is a Danish politician, lawyer, and current secretary general of the Danish branch of the WWF. She was a member of the Danish Folketinget parliament for the Conservative People's Party and New Alliance, and has previously been a Member of the European Parliament.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Gitte Seeberg, f\u00f6dd 25 juni 1960, \u00e4r en tidigare dansk EU-parlamentariker f\u00f6r Konservativa Folkpartiet. Hon satt i Folketinget fr\u00e5n 21 september 1994 tills hon kom in i EU-parlamentet, fr\u00e5n b\u00f6rjan f\u00f6r K\u00f6penhamns valkrets, men sedan 1998 f\u00f6r Roskildes valkrets. 2007 var hon med och bildade Ny Alliance p\u00e5 grund av missn\u00f6je med regeringens samarbete med Dansk Folkeparti. Hon blev d\u00e5 \u00e5ter invald i Folketinget, men l\u00e4mnade b\u00e5de detta och sitt nya parti \u00e5ret d\u00e4rp\u00e5. Hon har tagit kandidatexamen i juridik vid K\u00f6penhamns universitet.", "xml:lang": "sv"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Gitte Seeberg (ur. 25 czerwca 1960 w Kopenhadze) \u2013 du\u0144ska polityk i prawnik, pos\u0142anka do Folketingetu i Parlamentu Europejskiego, sekretarz generalny WWF w Danii.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Gitte Seeberg (* 25. Juni 1960 in Kopenhagen) ist eine d\u00e4nische Politikerin und seit 2008 Generalsekret\u00e4rin von WWF D\u00e4nemark.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Stawros Arnautakis, gr. \u03a3\u03c4\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c2 \u0391\u03c1\u03bd\u03b1\u03bf\u03c5\u03c4\u03ac\u03ba\u03b7\u03c2 (ur. 25 maja 1956 w Epano Archanes) \u2013 grecki polityk, samorz\u0105dowiec, od 2004 do 2009 pose\u0142 do Parlamentu Europejskiego, wiceminister gospodarki.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "St\u00e1vros Arnaout\u00e1kis (grec moderne : \u03a3\u03c4\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c2 \u0391\u03c1\u03bd\u03b1\u03bf\u03c5\u03c4\u03ac\u03ba\u03b7\u03c2 ; n\u00e9 le 25 mai 1956) est un homme politique grec membre du PASOK. Il fut d\u00e9put\u00e9 au Parlement europ\u00e9en dans le Groupe du Parti socialiste europ\u00e9en (PSE).", "xml:lang": "fr"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Stavros Arnaoutakis (Greek: \u03a3\u03c4\u03b1\u03cd\u03c1\u03bf\u03c2 \u0391\u03c1\u03bd\u03b1\u03bf\u03c5\u03c4\u03ac\u03ba\u03b7\u03c2; born 25 May 1956) is a Greek politician and former Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for the Panhellenic Socialist Movement (PASOK); part of the Party of European Socialists. He has also served as the Deputy Minister for the Economy. In the November 2010 elections, he was elected as the governor for the Crete Region, supported by PASOK.", "xml:lang": "en"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Stavros Arnaoutakis (* 25. Mai 1956 in Archanes) ist ein griechischer Politiker (PASOK) und gew\u00e4hlter Gouverneur der griechischen Region Kreta.", "xml:lang": "de"}}

PREFIX dbpr: <http://dbpedia.org/resour: {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Heinz Kindermann (born 20 June 1942 in Welhotta, Reichsgau Sudetenland) is a German politician who served as a Member of the European Parliament from 1994 until 2009. In parliament, Kindermann served on the Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development and the Committee on Fisheries. {"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Heinz Kindermann (ur. 20 czerwca 1942 w Trutnovie) \u2013 niemiecki polityk, lekarz weterynarii, przez trzy kadencje pose\u0142 do Parlamentu Europejskiego.", "xml:lang": "pl"}}

{"field": {"type": "literal", "value": "Heinz Kindermann (* 20. Juni 1942 in Welhota an der Elbe, Sudetenland) ist ein deutscher Politiker (SPD), der von 1994 bis 2009 dem Europ\u00e4ischen Parlament angeh\u00f6rte.", "xml:lang": "de"}}
